subject: Post-demo MAP: legal redlines ownership & SLAs (HelixData)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Erin Malone <erin.malone@helixdata.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@helixdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo MAP: legal redlines ownership & SLAs (HelixData)

Hi Erin / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Per our conversation I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners and target close. High-level callouts for the Legal milestone (MSA/DPA/SLA redlines):

- Who owns edits: HelixData legal to provide initial redline PDF; Redwood legal (Marissa Cole) will own consolidation and response.
- Sales coordination: Rafael Mendes (me) will own timeline tracking and HubSpot updates; Ben Carter will coordinate procurement playbook.
- TAT expectations: Initial acknowledgement within 24 business hours; 'simple' redlines (formatting, typos, non-substantive language) — target 48 hours; 'complex' redlines (new indemnity, SLA metric changes, data residency clauses) — target 5 business days with escalation.
- Triage & routing: Karthik Iyer will triage vendor/legal questions and assign to the right SME (privacy, security, platform). If an SLA or indemnity change is requested, we'll raise to legal leadership.
- Dependencies: security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence), third-party DPA, procurement PO approval. We need Helix to deliver their redline PDF and SOC evidence to move legal review.
- Target close: we proposed Dec 17, 2026 in the MAP (attached), contingent on timely legal turnaround.

Next steps:
1) Please send Helix's redline (PDF preferred) to marissa.cole@redwood.com and cc me; include a short list of the clauses you consider most urgent.
2) I'll add the MAP to the HubSpot deal (link below) and schedule a 30-min legal sync for Mon Nov 30 to walk the redlines.
3) We'll track everything in the shared Drive and use DocuSign for the final signature.

Attachments: helixdata-draft-MAP-v1.xlsx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/HLX-2026-019

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0137
From: Erin Malone <erin.malone@helixdata.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: legal redlines ownership & SLAs (HelixData)

Rafael —

Appreciate the recap and the MAP doc. A couple quick clarifying Qs before we circulate to our legal team:

- Can you define what you mean by 'complex' in practice? Example: if we ask to tighten the uptime SLA from 99.9% to 99.95%, is that complex?
- Will Redwood accept redlines as a tracked-change Word doc or do you prefer a PDF? We typically export tracked changes to PDF for outside counsel.
- For DocuSign: is that the final flow or can we do an interim signature on the MAP that commits both teams to the timeline (then MSA on DocuSign)?

I'll loop in our legal lead Carlos once we confirm preferred formats.

Best,
Erin Malone
VP Product, HelixData Inc.
erin.malone@helixdata.com
+1 (617) 555-0199

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Erin Malone <erin.malone@helixdata.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@helixdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: legal redlines ownership & SLAs (HelixData)

Thanks Erin — quick answers below and an updated process suggestion:

1) 'Complex' examples: changes to indemnity or liability caps; new data residency obligations; SLA metric changes that add new measurement/penalty mechanics (yes, tightening 99.9 -> 99.95% would be considered complex and requires engineering review).
2) Format: we accept either PDF or tracked-change Word. PDF is fine if that's Helix's export workflow; Word helps for line-by-line consolidation. If you send PDF, please include a short bullet list of the clauses you expect to push.
3) DocuSign flow: Proposed final signature via DocuSign on the MSA. We can do an interim signature on the MAP (mutual commitment) — I can prepare a one-page MAP signature block if you want that step.

Operationally I propose this routing:
- Helix sends redline (PDF or Word) to marissa.cole@redwood.com and cc me and karthik.iyer@redwood.com.
- Karthik will triage and route to privacy/security/engineering SMEs as needed.
- Marissa will perform initial legal consolidation and send a response with line-item notes.
- If change requires Commercial approval (pricing/SLA), Ben & I will confirm and loop leadership.

I've attached a one-page redline intake template (redlines_template.docx) and scheduled a 30-min legal sync for Mon Nov 30 10:00 PST — invite will go out separately.

Attachments: redlines_template.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-helix-map

-Rafael

Rafael / Karthik —

I'll take ownership of the redline review and consolidation for the MSA/DPA/SLA. Quick commitments from legal side:

- Initial intake acknowledgement: within 24 business hours of receipt.
- First-pass response time: target 72 business hours for a substantive initial pass (this covers most commercial redlines). If redlines touch indemnity, liability caps, or SLA penalties we'll plan on up to 5 business days to consult with engineering and leadership.
- Routing: please cc me and karthik on the incoming file. Karthik will assign to our SMEs; I'll produce a consolidated markup and a short memo outlining impacts.
- Escalation: if Helix requires SLA tightening or indemnity changes we'll need written justification; I'll escalate to Legal Lead and Amy (Head of Revenue Ops) for approval.

I can make the Nov 30 10:00 PST legal sync; if Erin/Carlos confirm I'll send a calendar update and a shared doc for live notes.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
